title: Articles 33–35 — Armed forces, martial law, and Part III legislation

content.overview: Article 33 empowers Parliament to modify Fundamental Rights for Armed Forces and certain public-order forces. Article 34 addresses martial law. Article 35 allocates legislative competence for certain Part III matters.
content.study: Material when FR challenges meet service law or martial-law context. Completes Part III; secondary depth vs Arts 12–32 for most exams.

sections.heading: Article 33
sections.body: Parliament may determine extent of Part III application to Armed Forces and related forces.
